name: Morgan City
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Morgan City, LA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Morgan City, Louisiana for 2026: a festival with a train ride, a parade and movie night, pancakes and more, checked with the host.
lede: Morgan City celebrates Christmas on the Atchafalaya with a downtown festival, a parade and movie night, a shrimp boat lighting and a pajama breakfast, with Berwick and Bayou Vista adding their own nights.
celebrates: Morgan City Main Street runs a string of Spirit of Morgan City events that start the weekend after Thanksgiving. The St. Mary Parish tourism calendar lists a shrimp boat lighting ceremony with a visit by Santa on November 27, a Christmas Festival at Lawrence Park on November 28 with a train ride, ice skating and the Lighting of the Oaks, and a Christmas Parade and Movie Night on December 4. Pancakes and PJs with the North Pole Crew follows on December 12. Nearby Berwick and Bayou Vista add a Rudolph night and a lighting ceremony.
lastyear: We did not find a host recap of Christmas 2025 in Morgan City. The 2026 calendar does show how long some traditions have run: the Spirit of Morgan City Moonlight Market is listed as the 14th annual and the Christmas Festival as the 5th annual, which means both took place in 2025 as well. The Mistletoe and Moss Holiday Market, hosted by the St. Mary Chamber of Commerce, is listed as its 8th annual.
facts: The Morgan City Christmas parade starts at the corner of Belanger and Second Street, goes down Second to Everett, around Lawrence Park, down Third Street, and ends under the bridge, according to the City of Morgan City. The festival's Lighting of the Oaks happens in Lawrence Park at 5:45 pm. Papa Noel's Cajun 12 Nights before Christmas Tours run from November 27 to December 24, priced at $30 for adults and $25 for children under 12, per the Cajun Coast calendar.
trains: The Spirit of Morgan City Christmas Festival lists a train ride at Lawrence Park on November 28, according to the Cajun Coast tourism calendar. We did not find a scheduled holiday train ride in Morgan City beyond that. The closest well-known rail option for a day trip is the Bayou Country Children's Museum in Thibodaux, which lists train rides at its Christmas with Coco evening on December 11 (see the Houma page).
traditions: Spirit of Morgan City Christmas Festival
A November 28 festival at Lawrence Park with Santa, the Grinch, a train ride, ice skating and the Lighting of the Oaks.
A free parade on December 4 followed by a movie.
A lighting ceremony with a visit by Santa on November 27 at Brashear and Federal Avenue.
A December 12 pajama breakfast with the North Pole Crew.
Christmas on the Lake, Cajun Style
A Christmas bonfire for Papa Noel at Lake End Park on December 23, listed on the Cajun Coast calendar.
kidfact: In Cajun Louisiana, families light Christmas bonfires so Papa Noel can find the way, and Morgan City has one at Lake End Park on December 23.
faq: When does Christmas start in Morgan City?

The Cajun Coast tourism calendar lists a Moonlight Market on November 26, a shrimp boat lighting ceremony with Santa on November 27 at 5:45 pm and the Christmas Festival at Lawrence Park on November 28 from 2 to 7 pm, so the season kicks off the weekend after Thanksgiving.
Is the Morgan City Christmas parade free?

Yes. The City of Morgan City lists entry for the Christmas Parade and Movie Night in the Park as free. It is on Friday, December 4, 2026, from 6 to 8 pm, with the parade starting at the corner of Belanger and Second Street.
Where can kids meet Santa in Morgan City?

The Christmas Festival at Lawrence Park on November 28 lists pictures with Santa and the Grinch. The shrimp boat lighting on November 27 lists a Santa visit at 5:45 pm, and Bayou Vista has a lighting ceremony with Santa on December 3.
Which towns near Morgan City have Christmas events?

The calendar lists Berwick (a riverfront lighting on December 1 and Rudolph on December 12), Bayou Vista (a lighting on December 3 and a parade on December 5) and Patterson (a parade on December 13). Franklin lists a parade and a lighting display on December 5.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Morgan City and nearby Berwick, Patterson, Franklin and Bayou Vista for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (the Spirit of Morgan City Christmas Festival at Lawrence Park) through December 13 (the Patterson Christmas Parade), with the Berwick Annual Christmas Lighting Ceremony (December 1), the Christmas Parade and Movie Night (December 4) and Franklin's Christmas Under the Lamppost Golf Cart Parade (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website or tourism calendar, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Morgan City

  • 8 Christmas events for kids in Morgan City, Berwick, Patterson, Franklin and Bayou Vista
  • 4 free events: the Morgan City Christmas Parade and Movie Night, Rudolph the Red Nosed Reindeer at Berwick Civic Center, the Franklin golf cart parade and the Patterson Christmas Parade
  • Meet Santa: the Christmas Festival (with the Grinch), Santa's boat arrival at the Berwick lighting, Pancakes and PJs and the Bayou Vista lighting
  • Parades and tree lightings: Christmas Parade (December 4), Franklin parade and lighting (December 5), Patterson parade (December 13), Berwick lighting (December 1) and the Lighting of the Oaks (November 28)
  • Trains: train rides at the Spirit of Morgan City Christmas Festival (November 28) and the Berwick lighting (December 1)
  • Season: November 28 to December 13
